# Phase_Transition_Tail_Transition

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where the probability distribution of extreme events shifts from exponential tails (ordered phase) to Gaussian tails (disordered phase) at a critical point. Offers a diagnostic signature for detecting phase transitions in complex networks and neural systems, useful for adaptive computing.
